"""Editable policy for agent_0 — this file is yours.

The worker imports this module once per deploy and calls its hooks:

    on_start(ctx)                once, when the worker starts
    on_observation(ctx, obs)     whenever a new observation arrives
    on_inbox(ctx, message)       whenever a peer message arrives
    on_tick(ctx)                 at the head's policy_hz

``ctx`` gives you ``state`` (a dict that survives between hooks),
``publish_action({"vx": .., "vy": .., "omega": ..})`` (body frame: +vx
forward, +vy left, +omega CCW; the head clips speed to 0.2 m/s and
|omega| to 0.5 rad/s), ``send_message(payload, recipient=None)``,
``status(payload)`` and ``log(message)``.

The harness publishes exactly one action per tick — yours if you commanded one
since the last tick, a zero action if you did not — so **publish every tick**.
Editing this file does NOT change what the robot runs: deploy it.

The workspace has the whole skill library under ``skills/`` — read it, call
it, copy from it. ``skills.policies.*`` are complete policies you can deploy
as they are.
"""

from skills import base_policy, frames

# Other useful entry points (see skills/ for the full library):
#   from skills import nav      nav.goto_point(obs, [x, y], state)
#   from skills import push     push.push_box(obs, state, box_id="box_0")
#   from skills import safety   safety.safe(obs, action)  # reflex + red light


def on_start(ctx):
    ctx.state["observation"] = None
    ctx.log("starter policy: holding position until told otherwise")


def on_observation(ctx, observation):
    ctx.state["observation"] = observation


def on_inbox(ctx, message):
    inbox = ctx.state.setdefault("inbox", [])
    inbox.append(message)
    del inbox[:-20]


def on_tick(ctx):
    obs = ctx.state.get("observation")
    if not obs:
        ctx.publish_action({"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0})
        ctx.status({"mode": "waiting_for_observation"})
        return

    # base_policy.act = stop + collision reflex + red-light guard (it runs
    # skills.safety.safe for you). Replace this line with your controller,
    # and keep passing your command through safety.safe.
    action = base_policy.act(obs, ctx.state)
    ctx.publish_action(action)

    x, y, _theta = frames.pose_of(obs)
    ctx.status(
        {
            "mode": "holding",
            "obs_seq": obs.get("seq"),
            "position": [round(x, 3), round(y, 3)],
        }
    )

"""agent_0 policy — blind ground robot.

self.sensing: obs_radius=0, localization=false, site_prior=false.
This robot cannot see walls, obstacles, peers, the goal, or even its own
pose/velocity. It cannot plan anything on its own. It depends entirely on
guidance messages from the aerial peer (agent_1), which can see everything
including this robot's own pose.

Protocol (proposed to agent_1 over chat, not yet confirmed as implemented
on their side): peer sends ctx.send_message a dict payload:
    {"type": "drive_cmd", "vx": <float>, "vy": <float>, "omega": <float>,
     "t": <sender's t_sim float>}
vx/vy/omega are body-frame for AGENT_0 (the sender must compute them using
its own knowledge of our pose/heading). We apply the most recent such
command if it arrived within MAX_CMD_AGE_S seconds (wall-clock, measured
from when *our* on_inbox actually read it) - otherwise we stop.
"""

import time

from skills import safety, comms

MAX_CMD_AGE_S = 1.0
HEARTBEAT_PERIOD_S = 1.0


def on_start(ctx):
    ctx.state["observation"] = None
    ctx.state["last_cmd"] = None          # {"vx","vy","omega"}
    ctx.state["last_cmd_recv_wall"] = None
    ctx.state["last_cmd_sender"] = None
    ctx.state["last_cmd_t_sent"] = None
    ctx.state["inbox_count"] = 0
    ctx.state["last_heartbeat_wall"] = 0.0
    ctx.log("agent_0: blind ground robot online, waiting for drive_cmd from a peer")


def on_observation(ctx, observation):
    ctx.state["observation"] = observation


def on_inbox(ctx, message):
    ctx.state["inbox_count"] = ctx.state.get("inbox_count", 0) + 1
    payload = comms.payload_of(message)
    sender = comms.sender_of(message)
    if isinstance(payload, dict) and payload.get("type") == "drive_cmd":
        try:
            vx = float(payload.get("vx", 0.0))
            vy = float(payload.get("vy", 0.0))
            omega = float(payload.get("omega", 0.0))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            ctx.log(f"agent_0: drive_cmd from {sender} had unparsable fields: {payload!r}")
            return
        ctx.state["last_cmd"] = {"vx": vx, "vy": vy, "omega": omega}
        ctx.state["last_cmd_recv_wall"] = time.time()
        ctx.state["last_cmd_sender"] = sender
        ctx.state["last_cmd_t_sent"] = payload.get("t")


def on_tick(ctx):
    now = time.time()

    last_cmd = ctx.state.get("last_cmd")
    recv_wall = ctx.state.get("last_cmd_recv_wall")
    age = (now - recv_wall) if recv_wall is not None else None
    fresh = last_cmd is not None and age is not None and age < MAX_CMD_AGE_S

    if fresh:
        action = {"vx": last_cmd["vx"], "vy": last_cmd["vy"], "omega": last_cmd["omega"]}
    else:
        action = {"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}

    # No wall/obstacle data at all (static_map null, sensing masked), so
    # skills.safety.safe's collision_reflex has nothing to check against;
    # just clamp to our speed limits.
    action = safety.clamp(action)
    ctx.publish_action(action)

    # Heartbeat so a peer's policy (and our own telemetry) can see we're alive.
    if now - ctx.state.get("last_heartbeat_wall", 0.0) >= HEARTBEAT_PERIOD_S:
        ctx.state["last_heartbeat_wall"] = now
        ctx.send_message({
            "type": "agent_0_heartbeat",
            "have_cmd": last_cmd is not None,
            "cmd_age_s": None if age is None else round(age, 2),
        })

    ctx.status({
        "mode": "following_peer_cmd" if fresh else "stopped_no_fresh_cmd",
        "last_cmd": last_cmd,
        "cmd_age_s": None if age is None else round(age, 2),
        "last_cmd_sender": ctx.state.get("last_cmd_sender"),
        "inbox_count": ctx.state.get("inbox_count", 0),
        "published": action,
    })

"""Aerial guide policy for agent_1 in guided_nav scenario.

agent_1 is an aerial robot with complete visibility over the site:
it observes the ground robot (agent_0), walls, pillars, moving obstacles,
and the scenario delivery zone.

agent_1 hovers safely in place and streams live navigation guidance
and safe body-frame control commands to agent_0 at 10 Hz.
"""

import math
from skills import comms, frames, nav, safety


def on_start(ctx):
    ctx.state["observation"] = None
    ctx.state["ground_nav_state"] = {}
    ctx.state["seq"] = 0
    ctx.state["inbox"] = []
    ctx.log("agent_1 aerial guide policy started")


def on_observation(ctx, observation):
    ctx.state["observation"] = observation


def on_inbox(ctx, message):
    inbox = ctx.state.setdefault("inbox", [])
    inbox.append(message)
    del inbox[:-20]


def _build_ground_obs(obs):
    """Extract agent_0 from peers and construct a synthetic ground robot observation."""
    for p in obs.get("peers", []):
        if p.get("agent_id") == "agent_0" and p.get("visible", False):
            return {
                "agent_id": "agent_0",
                "self": {
                    "pose": list(p["pose"]),
                    "velocity": list(p.get("velocity", [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])),
                    "half_extents": [0.16, 0.12],
                    "vertices": p.get("vertices"),
                    "body": {
                        "kind": "ground",
                        "max_speed": 0.2,
                    },
                },
                "static_map": obs.get("static_map"),
                "moving_obstacles": obs.get("moving_obstacles", []),
                "peers": [],  # agent_1 is aerial, passes above ground
                "global_signals": obs.get("global_signals", {}),
            }
    return None


def on_tick(ctx):
    obs = ctx.state.get("observation")
    if not obs:
        ctx.publish_action({"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0})
        ctx.status({"mode": "waiting_for_observation"})
        return

    # Agent_1 is aerial: hover safely in place.
    ctx.publish_action({"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0})

    # Locate goal and ground robot
    goal_info = obs.get("scenario", {}).get("goal")
    if not goal_info:
        ctx.status({"mode": "no_goal_in_scenario"})
        return

    goal_center = goal_info.get("center")
    goal_radius = goal_info.get("radius", 0.2)

    ground_obs = _build_ground_obs(obs)
    if not ground_obs:
        ctx.status({"mode": "waiting_for_ground_robot_visibility"})
        return

    pose = ground_obs["self"]["pose"]
    gx, gy = goal_center
    dx = gx - pose[0]
    dy = gy - pose[1]
    dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)

    ctx.state["seq"] += 1
    seq = ctx.state["seq"]
    t_sim = obs.get("t_sim", 0.0)

    # Determine command for agent_0.
    # Goal condition: inside circle (radius 0.20m) and stationary (<0.03 m/s) for 3.0s.
    # We aim for arrival within 0.08m of center to stop safely inside.
    if dist <= 0.08:
        at_goal = True
        target_action = {"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}
    else:
        at_goal = False
        nav_state = ctx.state.setdefault("ground_nav_state", {})
        try:
            cmd = nav.goto_point(
                ground_obs,
                goal_center,
                state=nav_state,
                max_speed=0.15,
                arrival_radius=0.08,
                route_around_moving=True,
                avoid_moving=True,
            )
            if cmd is None:
                target_action = {"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}
                at_goal = True
            else:
                # Apply safety wrapper (collision reflex against walls + clamping)
                target_action = safety.safe(ground_obs, cmd, min_clearance=0.10)
        except Exception as e:
            ctx.log(f"Error computing ground navigation: {e}")
            target_action = {"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}

    # Prepare broadcast payload with complete state and action aliases
    payload = {
        "type": "guidance",
        "seq": seq,
        "t_sim": round(t_sim, 2),
        "pose": [round(p, 4) for p in pose],
        "vel": [round(v, 4) for v in ground_obs["self"]["velocity"]],
        "goal": [round(gx, 4), round(gy, 4)],
        "goal_radius": goal_radius,
        "goal_distance": round(dist, 4),
        "at_goal": at_goal,
        "action": target_action,
        "recommended_action": target_action,
        "target_action": target_action,
    }

    ctx.send_message(payload, recipient="agent_0")

    # Read latest peer messages from inbox for telemetry
    inbox = ctx.state.get("inbox", [])
    latest_peer_msg = comms.payload_of(inbox[-1]) if inbox else None

    # Status heartbeat
    ctx.status(
        {
            "mode": "guiding",
            "seq": seq,
            "dist": round(dist, 3),
            "at_goal": at_goal,
            "agent_0_pose": [round(pose[0], 2), round(pose[1], 2), round(pose[2], 2)],
            "recommended_action": {
                "vx": round(target_action.get("vx", 0.0), 3),
                "vy": round(target_action.get("vy", 0.0), 3),
                "omega": round(target_action.get("omega", 0.0), 3),
            },
            "inbox_count": len(inbox),
            "latest_peer_msg": latest_peer_msg,
        }
    )

"""Aerial guide policy for agent_1 in guided_nav scenario.

agent_1 is an aerial robot with complete visibility over the site:
it observes the ground robot (agent_0), walls, pillars, moving obstacles,
and the scenario delivery zone.

agent_1 hovers safely in place and streams live navigation guidance
and safe body-frame control commands to agent_0 at 10 Hz matching
agent_0's expected drive_cmd protocol.
"""

import math
from skills import comms, frames, nav, safety


def on_start(ctx):
  ctx.state["observation"] = None
  ctx.state["ground_nav_state"] = {}
  ctx.state["seq"] = 0
  ctx.state["inbox"] = []
  ctx.state["at_goal"] = False
  ctx.log("agent_1 aerial guide policy started")


def on_observation(ctx, observation):
  ctx.state["observation"] = observation


def on_inbox(ctx, message):
  inbox = ctx.state.setdefault("inbox", [])
  inbox.append(message)
  del inbox[:-20]


def _build_ground_obs(obs):
  """Extract agent_0 from peers and construct a synthetic ground robot observation."""
  for p in obs.get("peers", []):
    if p.get("agent_id") == "agent_0" and p.get("visible", False):
      return {
          "agent_id": "agent_0",
          "self": {
              "pose": list(p["pose"]),
              "velocity": list(p.get("velocity", [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])),
              "half_extents": [0.16, 0.12],
              "vertices": p.get("vertices"),
              "body": {
                  "kind": "ground",
                  "max_speed": 0.2,
              },
          },
          "static_map": obs.get("static_map"),
          "moving_obstacles": obs.get("moving_obstacles", []),
          "peers": [],  # agent_1 is aerial, passes above ground
          "global_signals": obs.get("global_signals", {}),
      }
  return None


def on_tick(ctx):
  obs = ctx.state.get("observation")
  if not obs:
    ctx.publish_action({"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0})
    ctx.status({"mode": "waiting_for_observation"})
    return

  # Agent_1 is aerial: hover safely in place.
  ctx.publish_action({"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0})

  # Locate goal and ground robot
  goal_info = obs.get("scenario", {}).get("goal")
  if not goal_info:
    ctx.status({"mode": "no_goal_in_scenario"})
    return

  goal_center = goal_info.get("center")
  goal_radius = goal_info.get("radius", 0.2)

  ground_obs = _build_ground_obs(obs)
  if not ground_obs:
    ctx.status({"mode": "waiting_for_ground_robot_visibility"})
    return

  pose = ground_obs["self"]["pose"]
  gx, gy = goal_center
  dx = gx - pose[0]
  dy = gy - pose[1]
  dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)

  ctx.state["seq"] += 1
  seq = ctx.state["seq"]
  t_sim = obs.get("t_sim", 0.0)

  # Determine goal condition with hysteresis:
  # Stop when dist <= 0.08m (well inside 0.20m radius circle).
  # Remain stopped while dist <= 0.14m.
  at_goal = ctx.state.get("at_goal", False)
  if at_goal:
    if dist > 0.14:
      at_goal = False
  else:
    if dist <= 0.08:
      at_goal = True
  ctx.state["at_goal"] = at_goal

  if at_goal:
    target_action = {"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}
  else:
    nav_state = ctx.state.setdefault("ground_nav_state", {})
    try:
      cmd = nav.goto_point(
          ground_obs,
          goal_center,
          state=nav_state,
          max_speed=0.15,
          arrival_radius=0.08,
          route_around_moving=True,
          avoid_moving=True,
      )
      if cmd is None:
        target_action = {"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}
        at_goal = True
        ctx.state["at_goal"] = True
      else:
        # Apply safety wrapper (collision reflex against walls + clamping)
        target_action = safety.safe(ground_obs, cmd, min_clearance=0.10)
    except Exception as e:
      ctx.log(f"Error computing ground navigation: {e}")
      target_action = {"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}

  # Prepare broadcast payload matching agent_0's requested drive_cmd schema
  # along with comprehensive state fields
  vx_cmd = float(target_action.get("vx", 0.0))
  vy_cmd = float(target_action.get("vy", 0.0))
  omega_cmd = float(target_action.get("omega", 0.0))

  payload = {
      "type": "drive_cmd",
      "vx": vx_cmd,
      "vy": vy_cmd,
      "omega": omega_cmd,
      "t": float(t_sim),
      "seq": seq,
      "t_sim": round(t_sim, 2),
      "pose": [round(p, 4) for p in pose],
      "vel": [round(v, 4) for v in ground_obs["self"]["velocity"]],
      "goal": [round(gx, 4), round(gy, 4)],
      "goal_radius": goal_radius,
      "goal_distance": round(dist, 4),
      "at_goal": at_goal,
      "action": target_action,
      "recommended_action": target_action,
      "target_action": target_action,
  }

  ctx.send_message(payload, recipient="agent_0")

  # Read latest peer messages from inbox for telemetry
  inbox = ctx.state.get("inbox", [])
  latest_peer_msg = comms.payload_of(inbox[-1]) if inbox else None

  # Status heartbeat
  ctx.status({
      "mode": "guiding",
      "seq": seq,
      "dist": round(dist, 3),
      "at_goal": at_goal,
      "agent_0_pose": [
          round(pose[0], 2),
          round(pose[1], 2),
          round(pose[2], 2),
      ],
      "recommended_action": {
          "vx": round(vx_cmd, 3),
          "vy": round(vy_cmd, 3),
          "omega": round(omega_cmd, 3),
      },
      "inbox_count": len(inbox),
      "latest_peer_msg": latest_peer_msg,
  })

"""agent_0 policy — blind ground robot.

self.sensing: obs_radius=0, localization=false, site_prior=false.
This robot cannot see walls, obstacles, peers, the goal, or even its own
pose/velocity. It cannot plan anything on its own. It depends entirely on
guidance messages from the aerial peer (agent_1), which can see everything
including this robot's own pose.

Protocol (proposed to agent_1 over chat, not yet confirmed as implemented
on their side): peer sends ctx.send_message a dict payload:
    {"type": "drive_cmd", "vx": <float>, "vy": <float>, "omega": <float>,
     "t": <sender's t_sim float>}
vx/vy/omega are body-frame for AGENT_0 (the sender must compute them using
its own knowledge of our pose/heading). We apply the most recent such
command if it arrived within MAX_CMD_AGE_S seconds (wall-clock, measured
from when *our* on_inbox actually read it) - otherwise we stop.
"""

import time

from skills import safety, comms

MAX_CMD_AGE_S = 1.0
HEARTBEAT_PERIOD_S = 1.0


def on_start(ctx):
    ctx.state["observation"] = None
    ctx.state["last_cmd"] = None          # {"vx","vy","omega"}
    ctx.state["last_cmd_recv_wall"] = None
    ctx.state["last_cmd_sender"] = None
    ctx.state["last_cmd_t_sent"] = None
    ctx.state["inbox_count"] = 0
    ctx.state["last_heartbeat_wall"] = 0.0
    ctx.log("agent_0: blind ground robot online, waiting for drive_cmd from a peer")


def on_observation(ctx, observation):
    ctx.state["observation"] = observation


def on_inbox(ctx, message):
    ctx.state["inbox_count"] = ctx.state.get("inbox_count", 0) + 1
    payload = comms.payload_of(message)
    sender = comms.sender_of(message)
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return
    ptype = payload.get("type")

    if ptype == "drive_cmd":
        try:
            vx = float(payload.get("vx", 0.0))
            vy = float(payload.get("vy", 0.0))
            omega = float(payload.get("omega", 0.0))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            ctx.log(f"agent_0: drive_cmd from {sender} had unparsable fields: {payload!r}")
            return
        ctx.state["last_cmd"] = {"vx": vx, "vy": vy, "omega": omega}
        ctx.state["last_cmd_recv_wall"] = time.time()
        ctx.state["last_cmd_sender"] = sender
        ctx.state["last_cmd_t_sent"] = payload.get("t")
        ctx.state["last_cmd_kind"] = "drive_cmd"

    elif ptype == "guidance":
        act = payload.get("action") or {}
        try:
            vx = float(act.get("vx", 0.0))
            vy = float(act.get("vy", 0.0))
            omega = float(act.get("omega", 0.0))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            ctx.log(f"agent_0: guidance from {sender} had unparsable action: {payload!r}")
            return
        ctx.state["last_cmd"] = {"vx": vx, "vy": vy, "omega": omega}
        ctx.state["last_cmd_recv_wall"] = time.time()
        ctx.state["last_cmd_sender"] = sender
        ctx.state["last_cmd_t_sent"] = payload.get("t_sim")
        ctx.state["last_cmd_kind"] = "guidance"
        ctx.state["last_at_goal"] = bool(payload.get("at_goal", False))
        gd = payload.get("goal_distance")
        try:
            ctx.state["last_goal_distance"] = float(gd) if gd is not None else None
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            ctx.state["last_goal_distance"] = None


def on_tick(ctx):
    now = time.time()

    last_cmd = ctx.state.get("last_cmd")
    recv_wall = ctx.state.get("last_cmd_recv_wall")
    age = (now - recv_wall) if recv_wall is not None else None
    fresh = last_cmd is not None and age is not None and age < MAX_CMD_AGE_S

    at_goal = ctx.state.get("last_at_goal", False)
    goal_distance = ctx.state.get("last_goal_distance")
    near_goal = at_goal or (goal_distance is not None and goal_distance < 0.08)

    if fresh and near_goal:
        action = {"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}
    elif fresh:
        action = {"vx": last_cmd["vx"], "vy": last_cmd["vy"], "omega": last_cmd["omega"]}
    else:
        action = {"vx": 0.0, "vy": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}

    # No wall/obstacle data at all (static_map null, sensing masked), so
    # skills.safety.safe's collision_reflex has nothing to check against;
    # just clamp to our speed limits.
    action = safety.clamp(action)
    ctx.publish_action(action)

    # Heartbeat so a peer's policy (and our own telemetry) can see we're alive.
    if now - ctx.state.get("last_heartbeat_wall", 0.0) >= HEARTBEAT_PERIOD_S:
        ctx.state["last_heartbeat_wall"] = now
        ctx.send_message({
            "type": "agent_0_heartbeat",
            "have_cmd": last_cmd is not None,
            "cmd_age_s": None if age is None else round(age, 2),
        })

    if fresh and near_goal:
        mode = "holding_at_goal"
    elif fresh:
        mode = "following_peer_cmd"
    else:
        mode = "stopped_no_fresh_cmd"

    ctx.status({
        "mode": mode,
        "last_cmd": last_cmd,
        "last_cmd_kind": ctx.state.get("last_cmd_kind"),
        "cmd_age_s": None if age is None else round(age, 2),
        "last_cmd_sender": ctx.state.get("last_cmd_sender"),
        "at_goal": at_goal,
        "goal_distance": goal_distance,
        "inbox_count": ctx.state.get("inbox_count", 0),
        "published": action,
    })

chapters.title: Two different robots
chapters.description: Claude controls the ground robot. Gemini can see the scene. Each starts with its own local information.

chapters.title: Ask for a protocol
chapters.description: Claude proposes body-frame velocity commands called drive_cmd.

chapters.title: Two formats
chapters.description: Gemini deploys a sender using guidance.action. Claude’s receiver expects drive_cmd.

chapters.title: Make the programs agree
chapters.description: Gemini switches to drive_cmd. Claude then broadens its receiver to accept both formats.

chapters.title: Let the code coordinate
chapters.description: The deployed programs exchange commands while the LLMs continue their independent calls.

chapters.title: Reach the goal
chapters.description: The driver enters the goal, settles, and the episode succeeds at 164.5 seconds.

provenance.clock: producer t_wall relative to first env_step.t_wall minus first t_sim
provenance.framePolicy: latest recorded frame at or before the selected time; no physical interpolation
provenance.sourcePolicy: SHA-256 prefix matched to an actual spawn for that agent
provenance.messagePolicy: one producer send, with messenger delivery timestamps attached
provenance.selection: Illustrative successful cross-play episode, not a randomly selected performance estimate
